source: lab (real Orbbec Femto Mega recording, background removed with Segment Anything 2: everything except the table and ball is black)

camera.motion: static. Phase correlation of the table front edge + leg vs frame 0: |shift| <= 1 px in every frame (segmentation jitter), no pan/shake
camera.perspective: camera looks slightly down at a square/rectangular table top seen as a trapezoid: back edge y~430-437 (x 461..~765, ~300 px long), front edge y~520-548 (x 302..911, ~610 px long). Front edge is nearer the camera (2x longer in image). Horizon is above the table, not visible (black background).

objects.name: ball
objects.description: the only moving object: small white/pale-pink ball (looks like a ping-pong / light foam ball). Thrown up from above the table centre, bounces on the table top twice, rolls/moves toward the camera and slightly left, falls off the FRONT edge of the table and leaves the image at the bottom
objects.reference_point: centroid of the brighter-than-background mask (visible centre); in blurred frames the centroid of the blur streak = centre at mid-exposure

apparent_diameter_px.note: use minor_extent_px (across the blur) as the diameter; grows with time because the ball comes toward the camera (depth decreases ~2x from frame 0 to frame 34)

objects.name: table
objects.description: wooden (light brown) table top on a single dark grey central pedestal leg; static
objects.front_edge_thickness_px: about 26 (left) to 23 (right) px (front face of the top slab)

objects.name: watermark
objects.description: text 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' at bottom-right (x 1040-1300, y 698-714); not a physical object

events.event: ball held/nearly static above table centre (hand removed by segmentation)
start of upward motion / release (throw up)
events.note: cy 236.2 (f2) -> 234.5 (f3) -> 222.0 (f4); release between f3 and f4
f9 cy 181.4 nearly equal; true apex ~f8.3

events.event: first impact on the table top, near its back edge
events.note: lowest position (blur streak bottom y 437, back edge y~430); f15 already rising
f24 still falling (blur streak), f25 lowest
cy 427.2, 428.8 (~7 px up) then down again

events.event: ball rolling/moving on table top toward camera and leftwards
events.note: image motion (-x, +y), speed in px increasing

events.event: ball leaves the front edge of the table
events.note: f35 bottom at y 533 at the front edge; f36 below the edge in free fall

events.event: falling below table, leaves image through bottom edge
events.note: f37-38 cut by image bottom; not visible from f39 (t 1.625)
